{{Top|leg}}
'''Drovian''' was the name of one of the two major tribes of the [[Drovian|eponymous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on [[Nim Drovis]]. It was in a [[Nim Drovis Civil War|civil war]] for hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] with the [[Gopso'o]] tribe.
